definitions.explanation: The area close to something or someone.
Close to a number or amount.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くに{住|す}んでいます。
3{万|まん}{円|えん}{近|ちか}く{使|つか}った。
{近|ちか}くの{店|みせ}で{買|か}い{物|もの}をした。
examples.english: I went shopping at a nearby store.

examples.japanese: 100{人|にん}{近|ちか}くが{参加|さんか}した。
{学校|がっこう}の{近|ちか}くに{新|あたら}しいコンビニができた。
examples.english: A new convenience store opened near the school.

examples.japanese: 1{年|ねん}{近|ちか}く{日本|にほん}に{住|す}んでいる。
examples.english: I've been living in Japan for nearly a year.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}{遅|おそ}くまで{働|はたら}いて、12{時|じ}{近|ちか}くに{家|いえ}に{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: I worked until late at night and got home close to midnight.

notes:
{近|ちか}く has two main uses: "nearby/vicinity" (location) and "nearly/almost" (approximate amount).

LOCATION USE:
- {駅|えき}の{近|ちか}く: near the station
- {近|ちか}くの{店|みせ}: nearby shop
- この{近|ちか}く: around here

APPROXIMATION USE:
- 100{人|にん}{近|ちか}く: nearly 100 people
- 1{時間|じかん}{近|ちか}く: nearly an hour
- 3{万|まん}{円|えん}{近|ちか}く: close to 30,000 yen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {付近|ふきん}: vicinity (more formal)
- {辺|あた}り: area, around
- {近所|きんじょ}: neighborhood
- {近|ちか}い: near (adjective)

NOTE:
{近|ちか}く can modify nouns with の: {近|ちか}くの + noun.
